Updated the endpoint to only accept the "email_change" OTP type.

1. Removed the unused import: removed `VALID_EMAIL_OTP_TYPES` from the imports since it's no longer needed.
2. Replaced the permissive check: changed lines 15-18 from:
   ```typescript
   const type: EmailOtpType | null = 
     typeParam && (VALID_EMAIL_OTP_TYPES as readonly string[]).includes(typeParam)
       ? (typeParam as EmailOtpType)
       : null;
   ```
   to:
   ```typescript
   const type: EmailOtpType | null = 
     typeParam === "email_change" ? ("email_change" as EmailOtpType) : null;
   ```

The endpoint now only accepts `typeParam === "email_change"`; any other value sets `type` to `null`, which prevents processing invalid OTP types. This restricts the endpoint to email change confirmations only.
